data_deps.name: video_frame_interp_real
data_deps.description: Fixed (frame0, frame2, true-middle-frame) 64x64 triplets for the vfi-* VIDEO FRAME INTERPOLATION tasks, at THREE distinct inter-frame MOTION MAGNITUDES (small / medium / large), sourced from REAL video -- the Vimeo-90K temporal-frame-interpolation test set (Xue et al., TOFlow, IJCV 2019; http://toflow.csail.mit.edu/, direct no-login zip download, ~2.99GB, cached under a host-side cache dir so re-runs are offline). frame0/frame2 are two real consecutively-decoded frames (im1/im3) and `gt` is the REAL frame the camera captured half-way between them (im2) -- nothing is synthetically warped or composited. Sequences are bucketed into small/medium/large by their MEASURED Farneback optical-flow magnitude between frame0/frame2 (computed once at prep time), then split train/val (2000/400 per setting) with disjoint source-video IDs. As motion grows a naive linear blend of the two frames ghosts and its PSNR collapses, while flow-warp and learned flow+refinement synthesis stay closer to GT -- so the blend < flow_warp < learned partial-order is expected to hold and widen across the three settings (verified by CPU smoke test; see anchors). Requires network on the HOST for the one-time download, numpy/pillow/opencv-python for the prep scan; the task container itself is fully offline and only reads the pre-built train.npz/val.npz. `prepare_data.py` builds all three settings together (they share one motion scan).
